relationships.name: fct_policy_premiums_to_dim_policies
relationships.description: Each premium transaction belongs to one policy. A policy can have multiple premium transactions.

relationships.name: fct_claims_to_dim_policies
relationships.description: Each claim is associated with one policy. A policy can have multiple claims.

relationships.name: fct_claim_payments_to_fct_claims
relationships.description: Each payment transaction belongs to one claim. A claim can have multiple payment transactions.

relationships.name: dim_policies_to_dim_agents
relationships.description: Each policy is sold/serviced by one agent. An agent can handle multiple policies.

relationships.name: dim_agents_to_dim_agencies
relationships.description: Each agent is affiliated with one agency. An agency can have multiple agents.

relationships.name: fct_claims_to_dim_line_of_business
relationships.description: Each claim is categorized under one line of business. A line of business can have multiple claims.

relationships.name: dim_policies_to_dim_line_of_business
relationships.description: Each policy belongs to one line of business. A line of business can have multiple policies.

relationships.name: dim_policies_to_dim_states
relationships.description: Each policy is issued in one state. A state can have multiple policies.

relationships.name: dim_agencies_to_dim_states
relationships.description: Each agency is located in one state. A state can have multiple agencies.

relationships.name: fct_claims_to_dim_cause_of_loss
relationships.description: Each claim has one cause of loss. A cause can be associated with multiple claims.

metadata.description: Mart-level relationships for Sentinel Insurance data model. This file documents joins between fact and dimension tables in the marts layer only.
notes: All relationships use LEFT OUTER JOIN to preserve all records from the left table
Many-to-one relationships indicate that multiple records on the left can reference one record on the right
LOB_CODE and STATE_CODE are business keys used for dimensional lookups
